svg.title: Separated qualification and evaluation workflow
svg.desc: Eight stages: prepare, train, explore, fit, select, confirm, admit and evaluate. Official training is divided 60/20/10/10 into fit, exploration, selection and confirmation roles. The candidate registry is frozen before selection. Confirmation fixes the candidate and comparator before official validation admission. Passing admission retains the executable candidate; failure returns the comparator. The final policy is locked before official test labels are used. This is the repository's separated sequence, not the reused-validation protocol of the reported results.

text.tspan: Qualify a policy before opening the test labels
Eight sealed stages · separated label roles · one final deployment decision
Freeze encoder, native blocks and task head
Log transitions and paired action effects
Fit the observer and consequence models
Freeze learned models and empirical radii
Retain or downgrade the candidate q
Required contrasts · eligible predecessor or q
Compare the fixed executable rule with q
Loss + metric gates choose the final rule q
Task metrics + paired effects; no policy changes
POLICY LOCK · FINAL RULE FIXED BEFORE TEST
Separated execution shown. The paper's reused-validation admission statistics remain descriptive.
